title: Empirical Analysis of LLM Scaling Laws
snippet: Compute scaling correlates directly with downstream benchmarks up to 10^25 FLOPs. Beyond that, data quality becomes the primary bottleneck.

title: Agentic Workflows vs Zero-Shot Reasoning
snippet: Multi-agent reflection loops increase accuracy on complex mathematical and coding tasks by 34% compared to single-pass prompting.

title: Hardware Trends in AI Accelerator Chips
snippet: FP8 and INT4 quantization lower GPU VRAM requirements by up to 75% without significant degradation in perplexity for 70B parameter models.
